The serial check was skipped (T5) because the serial rule isn't in the program rules, so it doesn't apply.

Because the label photo is unreadable, the claim can't be confirmed from the label. The policy says that without a usable label reading, the typed model decides, and it matches a recalled model. So the claim can be approved on the typed model.
